author: reek
body: A LayeredPermanent carries a Permanent through the layer pipeline together with the characteristics the Permanent record does not itself hold: its current colours (layer 5) and its current type line (layer 4). reset-to-base seeds the colours from the template's colour and the type line from the template's card type plus its subtypes. Layers 4 and 5 rewrite colours and types here; layers 6 and 7 rewrite the inner Permanent's keywords and P/T modifiers.
